title: Neurologist steers Jim toward John Mack and Ray Fowler
place_text: Boston area, Massachusetts (Beth Israel / Harvard Medical School; Marriott hotel conference)

tellings.quote: few days later he came into my room and said look you know this guy named Ray Fowler Raymond Fowler is going to he's a UFO investigator and he's going to be at this um conference

plain: In 1976, while Jim Weiner was in the hospital in the Boston area, a neurologist named Jonathan Silverman pointed him toward people who looked into UFO encounters. Weiner, who says he was abducted by aliens, tells Michels about it himself. He says that a few days into his stay the doctor came into his room and told him about "a UFO investigator" named Raymond Fowler who would be speaking at a conference at a Marriott hotel, and the doctor also named John Mack.
